import argparse, json, logging, os
from collections import Counter
import torch
from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CLS_SYSTEM = ("You are a code verifier. Given a code snippet and a test case, "
              "predict whether the test will pass or fail.")
TRAJ_SYSTEM = ("You are a code repair verifier. Given the code patch and test summary, "
               "predict whether all tests pass (resolved) or any test fails (unresolved).")

CONFIGS = [
    {"name": "cls_seed42",  "ckpt": "checkpoints_seed42/best",        "data": "data/test.jsonl",      "mode": "cls",  "out": "predictions_cls_seed42.jsonl"},
    {"name": "cls_seed123", "ckpt": "checkpoints_seed123/best",       "data": "data/test.jsonl",      "mode": "cls",  "out": "predictions_cls_seed123.jsonl"},
    {"name": "cls_seed456", "ckpt": "checkpoints_seed456/best",       "data": "data/test.jsonl",      "mode": "cls",  "out": "predictions_cls_seed456.jsonl"},
    {"name": "traj_seed42",  "ckpt": "checkpoints_traj/best",         "data": "data/traj_test.jsonl", "mode": "traj", "out": "predictions_traj_seed42.jsonl"},
    {"name": "traj_seed123", "ckpt": "checkpoints_traj_seed123/best", "data": "data/traj_test.jsonl", "mode": "traj", "out": "predictions_traj_seed123.jsonl"},
    {"name": "traj_seed456", "ckpt": "checkpoints_traj_seed456/best", "data": "data/traj_test.jsonl", "mode": "traj", "out": "predictions_traj_seed456.jsonl"},
]

def load_jsonl(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]

def detect_thinking_support(tokenizer):
    try:
        tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], tokenize=False, enable_thinking=False)
        return {"enable_thinking": False}
    except TypeError:
        return {}

def build_ids(tokenizer, item, mode, tmpl_kw, max_len):
    if mode == "cls":
        user_msg = f"## Code\n{item['code']}\n\n## Test\n{item['test']}\n\nWill this test pass or fail?"
        system = CLS_SYSTEM
    else:
        user_msg = f"[Code]\n{item['code']}\n\n[Test Summary]\n{item['test_summary']}"
        system = TRAJ_SYSTEM
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}]
    ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, **tmpl_kw)
    return ids[:max_len] if len(ids) > max_len else ids

def parse_pred(text, mode):
    if "</think>" in text:
        text = text.split("</think>")[-1]
    t = text.strip().lower()
    if mode == "cls":

        if t.startswith("fail"): return 0
        if "pass" in t and "fail" not in t: return 1
        if "fail" in t and "pass" not in t: return 0
    else:
        if t.startswith("resolved"): return 1
        if t.startswith("unresolved"): return 0
        if "resolved" in t and "unresolved" not in t: return 1
        if "unresolved" in t: return 0
    return -1

    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

CLS_SYSTEM = ("You are a code verifier. Given a code snippet and a test case, "

               "predict whether all tests pass (resolved) or any test fails (unresolved).")

BASE_DIR = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier"

    {"name": "traj_seed789", "ckpt": "checkpoints_traj_seed789/best",  "data": "data/traj_test.jsonl", "mode": "traj", "out": "predictions_traj_seed789.jsonl"},
    {"name": "traj_seed0",   "ckpt": "checkpoints_traj_seed0/best",    "data": "data/traj_test.jsonl", "mode": "traj", "out": "predictions_traj_seed0.jsonl"},
]

def load_jsonl(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]

def detect_thinking_support(tokenizer):
    try:
        tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], tokenize=False, enable_thinking=False)
        return {"enable_thinking": False}
    except TypeError:
        return {}

def build_ids(tokenizer, item, mode, tmpl_kw, max_len):
    if mode == "cls":
        user_msg = f"## Code\n{item['code']}\n\n## Test\n{item['test']}\n\nWill this test pass or fail?"
        system = CLS_SYSTEM
    else:
        user_msg = f"[Code]\n{item['code']}\n\n[Test Summary]\n{item['test_summary']}"
        system = TRAJ_SYSTEM
    msgs = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}]
    ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, **tmpl_kw)
    return ids[:max_len] if len(ids) > max_len else ids

def parse_pred(text, mode):
    if "</think>" in text:
        text = text.split("</think>")[-1]
    t = text.strip().lower()

        if t.startswith("pass"): return 1
        if t.startswith("fail"): return 0
        if "pass" in t and "fail" not in t: return 1
        if "fail" in t and "pass" not in t: return 0
    else:
        if t.startswith("resolved"): return 1
        if t.startswith("unresolved"): return 0
        if "resolved" in t and "unresolved" not in t: return 1
        if "unresolved" in t: return 0
    return -1

def run_one(cfg):
    out_path = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, cfg["out"])

        log.info(f"[{cfg['name']}] Skip — {out_path} exists")

    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    tmpl_kw = detect_thinking_support(tokenizer)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLS vs CWM per-instance error overlap analysis."""
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def load_cls_predictions(path):
    preds = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            preds.append(json.loads(line))
    return preds

def load_cwm_predictions(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    return data["predictions"]

def cohens_kappa(y1, y2):
    n = len(y1)
    assert n == len(y2)
    cats = sorted(set(y1) | set(y2))
    confusion = Counter()
    for a, b in zip(y1, y2):
        confusion[(a, b)] += 1
    po = sum(confusion[(c, c)] for c in cats) / n
    pe = sum(
        (sum(confusion[(c, c2)] for c2 in cats) / n) *
        (sum(confusion[(c2, c)] for c2 in cats) / n)
        for c in cats
    )
    if pe == 1.0:
        return 1.0
    return (po - pe) / (1.0 - pe)

def compute_f1_prec_rec(labels, preds, pos_label):
    tp = sum(1 for l, p in zip(labels, preds) if l == pos_label and p == pos_label)
    fp = sum(1 for l, p in zip(labels, preds) if l != pos_label and p == pos_label)
    fn = sum(1 for l, p in zip(labels, preds) if l == pos_label and p != pos_label)
    prec = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
    rec = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec) if (prec + rec) > 0 else 0.0
    return {"precision": round(prec * 100, 2), "recall": round(rec * 100, 2), "f1": round(f1 * 100, 2), "support": tp + fn}

def main():
    cls_path = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/predictions_cls_seed42.jsonl"
    cwm_path = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/eval_cwm_seed42_with_preds_predictions.json"
    out_path = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/error_overlap_analysis.json"

    cls_preds = load_cls_predictions(cls_path)
    cwm_preds = load_cwm_predictions(cwm_path)

    assert len(cls_preds) == len(cwm_preds), f"Size mismatch: CLS={len(cls_preds)}, CWM={len(cwm_preds)}"
    n = len(cls_preds)

    # Build lookup by index
    cwm_by_idx = {p["idx"]: p for p in cwm_preds}

    both_correct = []
    cls_only_correct = []
    cwm_only_correct = []
    both_wrong = []

    by_mutation = defaultdict(lambda: {"both_correct": 0, "cls_only": 0, "cwm_only": 0, "both_wrong": 0, "total": 0})
    by_problem = defaultdict(lambda: {"both_correct": 0, "cls_only": 0, "cwm_only": 0, "both_wrong": 0, "total": 0})

    cls_correct_list = []
    cwm_correct_list = []

    cwm_labels = []
    cwm_pred_labels = []
    cwm_mutation_data = defaultdict(lambda: {"labels": [], "preds": [], "exact_matches": []})

    for cls_p in cls_preds:
        idx = cls_p["index"]
        cwm_p = cwm_by_idx[idx]
        
        cls_correct = (cls_p["pred"] == cls_p["label"])
        cwm_pred_val = 1 if cwm_p["predicted_label"] == "PASS" else 0
        cwm_label_val = 1 if cwm_p["true_label"] == "PASS" else 0
        cwm_correct_val = (cwm_pred_val == cwm_label_val)

        cls_correct_list.append(1 if cls_correct else 0)
        cwm_correct_list.append(1 if cwm_correct_val else 0)

        mt = cls_p["mutation_type"]
        pid = cls_p["problem_id"]

        cwm_labels.append(cwm_label_val)
        cwm_pred_labels.append(cwm_pred_val)
        cwm_mutation_data[mt]["labels"].append(cwm_label_val)
        cwm_mutation_data[mt]["preds"].append(cwm_pred_val)
        cwm_mutation_data[mt]["exact_matches"].append(1 if cwm_p.get("exact_match", False) else 0)

        item = {"index": idx, "problem_id": pid, "mutation_type": mt}

        if cls_correct and cwm_correct_val:
            both_correct.append(item)
            cat = "both_correct"
        elif cls_correct and not cwm_correct_val:
            cls_only_correct.append(item)
            cat = "cls_only"
        elif not cls_correct and cwm_correct_val:
            cwm_only_correct.append(item)
            cat = "cwm_only"
        else:
            both_wrong.append(item)
            cat = "both_wrong"

        by_mutation[mt][cat] += 1
        by_mutation[mt]["total"] += 1
        by_problem[pid][cat] += 1
        by_problem[pid]["total"] += 1

    # Cohen's kappa on correctness
    kappa_correctness = cohens_kappa(cls_correct_list, cwm_correct_list)

    # Cohen's kappa on predictions (pass/fail)
    cls_pred_binary = [p["pred"] for p in cls_preds]
    cwm_pred_binary = [1 if cwm_by_idx[p["index"]]["predicted_label"] == "PASS" else 0 for p in cls_preds]
    kappa_predictions = cohens_kappa(cls_pred_binary, cwm_pred_binary)

    # CWM per-class F1 by mutation type
    cwm_per_mutation_f1 = {}
    for mt, data in sorted(cwm_mutation_data.items()):
        labels = data["labels"]
        preds = data["preds"]
        em = data["exact_matches"]
        pass_metrics = compute_f1_prec_rec(labels, preds, 1)
        fail_metrics = compute_f1_prec_rec(labels, preds, 0)
        acc = sum(1 for l, p in zip(labels, preds) if l == p) / len(labels) * 100
        em_rate = sum(em) / len(em) * 100
        cwm_per_mutation_f1[mt] = {
            "total": len(labels),
            "accuracy": round(acc, 2),
            "exact_match_rate": round(em_rate, 2),
            "pass_f1": pass_metrics,
            "fail_f1": fail_metrics,
        }

    cls_only_problems = set()
    cwm_only_problems = set()
    for pid, counts in by_problem.items():
        if counts["cls_only"] > 0 and counts["cwm_only"] == 0:
            cls_only_problems.add(pid)
        elif counts["cwm_only"] > 0 and counts["cls_only"] == 0:
            cwm_only_problems.add(pid)

    # Sort mutation breakdown
    mutation_breakdown = {}
    for mt in sorted(by_mutation.keys()):
        d = by_mutation[mt]
        t = d["total"]
        mutation_breakdown[mt] = {
            "total": t,
            "both_correct": d["both_correct"],
            "both_correct_pct": round(d["both_correct"] / t * 100, 1),
            "cls_only_correct": d["cls_only"],
            "cls_only_correct_pct": round(d["cls_only"] / t * 100, 1),
            "cwm_only_correct": d["cwm_only"],
            "cwm_only_correct_pct": round(d["cwm_only"] / t * 100, 1),
            "both_wrong": d["both_wrong"],
            "both_wrong_pct": round(d["both_wrong"] / t * 100, 1),
        }

    # Find CWM weakest mutation types (by accuracy)
    cwm_weakest = sorted(cwm_per_mutation_f1.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["accuracy"])[:3]

    results = {
        "total_samples": n,
        "overlap_summary": {
            "both_correct": len(both_correct),
            "both_correct_pct": round(len(both_correct) / n * 100, 2),
            "cls_only_correct": len(cls_only_correct),
            "cls_only_correct_pct": round(len(cls_only_correct) / n * 100, 2),
            "cwm_only_correct": len(cwm_only_correct),
            "cwm_only_correct_pct": round(len(cwm_only_correct) / n * 100, 2),
            "both_wrong": len(both_wrong),
            "both_wrong_pct": round(len(both_wrong) / n * 100, 2),
        },
        "complementarity": {
            "cls_unique_correct": len(cls_only_correct),
            "cwm_unique_correct": len(cwm_only_correct),
            "union_correct": len(both_correct) + len(cls_only_correct) + len(cwm_only_correct),
            "union_accuracy_pct": round((len(both_correct) + len(cls_only_correct) + len(cwm_only_correct)) / n * 100, 2),
            "oracle_gain_over_cls_pp": round(len(cwm_only_correct) / n * 100, 2),
            "oracle_gain_over_cwm_pp": round(len(cls_only_correct) / n * 100, 2),
        },
        "cohens_kappa": {
            "on_correctness": round(kappa_correctness, 4),
            "on_predictions": round(kappa_predictions, 4),
        },
        "mutation_type_breakdown": mutation_breakdown,
        "cwm_per_mutation_f1": cwm_per_mutation_f1,
        "cwm_weakest_mutation_types": [{"mutation_type": mt, "accuracy": d["accuracy"], "exact_match_rate": d["exact_match_rate"]} for mt, d in cwm_weakest],
        "problems_cls_only_succeeds": sorted(list(cls_only_problems))[:20],
        "problems_cwm_only_succeeds": sorted(list(cwm_only_problems))[:20],
        "n_problems_cls_only": len(cls_only_problems),
        "n_problems_cwm_only": len(cwm_only_problems),
    }

    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
